description: Source code for the Ethernet driver 'eth_adin2111' in Zephyr RTOS, implementing SPI communication, device initialization, and network interface setup for the ADIN2111 Ethernet controller.

methods.name: eth_adin2111_lock
methods.description: Locks the device mutex with a specified timeout.

methods.name: eth_adin2111_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the device mutex.

methods.name: eth_adin2111_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit register value over SPI to the device.

methods.name: eth_adin2111_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit register value over SPI from the device.

methods.name: adin2111_read_fifo
methods.description: Reads a frame from the device FIFO for a specified port.

methods.name: adin2111_port_on_phyint
methods.description: Handles PHY interrupt for a port, toggling carrier status.

methods.name: adin2111_offload_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling device interrupts and data processing.

methods.name: adin2111_int_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback for device interrupt, signals the offload thread.

methods.name: adin2111_read_tx_space
methods.description: Reads available transmit space from the device.

methods.name: adin2111_port_send
methods.description: Sends a network packet via the device port.

methods.name: adin2111_config_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes device configuration by setting the SYNC bit.

methods.name: adin2111_write_filter_address
methods.description: Writes MAC address filtering rules to the device.

methods.name: adin2111_filter_multicast
methods.description: Sets multicast filtering rules.

methods.name: adin2111_filter_broadcast
methods.description: Sets broadcast filtering rules.

methods.name: adin2111_filter_unicast
methods.description: Sets unicast filtering rules for a specific address and port.

methods.name: adin2111_port_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes network interface for a port, sets filters and starts processing.

methods.name: adin2111_port_get_capabilities
methods.description: Returns hardware capabilities of the port.

methods.name: adin2111_port_set_config
methods.description: Sets port configuration, e.g., MAC address.

methods.name: adin2111_port_get_stats
methods.description: Returns network statistics for the port.

methods.name: adin2111_check_spi
methods.description: Checks SPI communication by reading PHY ID.

methods.name: adin2111_await_device
methods.description: Waits for device to come out of reset.

methods.name: adin2111_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, configures GPIOs, resets, and sets registers.
